items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: The manager was Harold Oxley... he was the manager of the band... Lunceford had a publishing house... He and Harold Oxley -- and we placed our tunes in his -- he was a publisher.

ctx.x: Who was (inaudible)? Who was managing it?
The manager was Harold Oxley. But I don't know who was really booking the band, but I know he had -- he was the manager of the band, and we did an awful lot of onenighters.
You played all over the country, didn't you?
